The decorative machinery is purposeless clutter, but the plan does not ask it to explain additional propositions."},{"check":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","status":"PASS","evidence":"The only meaningful state transition is from separated halves to joined halves; no obsolete mechanism is described as persisting across later claims."},{"check":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"The paper halves and Bot form one active semantic group. The surrounding objects are not assigned additional actions or claims, so they constitute clutter rather than multiple dominant semantic groups."},{"check":"COMPOSITIONAL_STAGNATION","status":"PASS","evidence":"There is only one setup and one proposition, so no sequence of unrelated propositions repeats the same composition."},{"check":"CONTINUITY_TOKEN_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"No continuity tokens are planned, and the film ends after s1."},{"check":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","status":"FAIL","evidence":"In s1, the composition explicitly adds six decorative gears, pipes, unused receipt boxes, and competing signs solely to fill space, with no story, location, action, or balance function."},{"check":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","status":"PASS","evidence":"The complete narration expresses one semantic rule in one setup and then ends; no semantic shift requires an intermediate reset."},{"check":"COMPETING_FOCI","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Although the joint is central, s1 surrounds it with six unrelated decorative mechanisms and explicitly described competing signs. This planned hierarchy makes the joining contact compete with non-story elements during a quick glance."},{"check":"CAPTION_CARRIES_STORY","status":"PASS","evidence":"The central action visibly supplies the meaning without captions: large paper halves begin apart, Bot pushes them together, and they end joined."}],"setup_assessments":[{"setup_id":"s1","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The setup has a coherent joining rule and visible before/after state, but its planned composition deliberately surrounds the contact with purposeless machinery and competing signage, causing clutter and hierarchy failures."}],"violations":[{"code":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Six gears, pipes, unused receipt boxes, and signs are included solely to make the frame busy rather than to communicate story, location, action, or balance.","smallest_structural_correction":"Remove the unrelated fill objects; retain the two paper halves, Bot, work surface, backboard, and the purposeful corner crop."},{"code":"COMPETING_FOCI","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"The joining contact is intended as the focal action, but unrelated surrounding machinery and explicitly competing signs create rival attention targets.","smallest_structural_correction":"Reserve the central contact as the sole dominant region and eliminate the competing signs and machinery, allowing at most one clearly subordinate location cue."}],"limits":"This is a data-only review of planned structure and hierarchy.
